notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.8 | NEW JUNGLE MAP & PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.0.8

I hope you have a great day. In today's patch we got:

- A new jungle themed map in the usual 8 main variations
- Performance adjustments 

If you got any ideas, wishes or feedback for future updates or content, just let me know in the comments.

Thank you very much and greetings, Dev

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.7 | FOV, SCOPE VIEW & MORE
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.0.7

I hope you have a great day. In today's patch we got:

- FOV adjustment based on player feedback
- Scope view resolution scaled up
- Grass is now moving smoothly
- Map selection interface updated in preparation for a new upcoming map
- Minor main menu button changes

If you got any ideas, wishes or feedback for future updates or content, just let me know in the comments.

Thank you very much and greetings, Dev
